description: This Java class defines an immutable event called 'FeaturePropertyModified' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an event emitted after a property of a feature in a thing has been modified, containing details such as feature ID, property JSON pointer, property value, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata. The class provides factory methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON objects, and overrides methods for payload serialization, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a modification to a property of a feature in a thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes details like feature ID, property JSON pointer, property value, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata. Provides methods for creation from parameters or JSON, and serialization for event payloads.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new FeaturePropertyModified instance with detailed parameters including optional timestamp and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, requiring corresponding headers.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose property was modified.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the modified property.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the modified property.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
